published_levelB.ambiguity: AMB-02; P10_11's quotient image DIFFERS between readings

pure_N4125.ambiguity: none -- the sector uses no explicit bracket at all
pure_N4125.manifest_symmetry: only the intrinsic Young symmetry of N^(4125)

do_not_merge: algebraic, notational, computational and source-robustness simplicity are different notions and are reported separately
metric_note: Runtime figures are NOT directly comparable: the published evaluators rebuild composite_n1050 on every call (890 ms mean) while the reverse evaluator receives cached blocks (119 ms mean). The shared block build is 1.62 s. A fair head-to-head would require refactoring the published evaluators to accept cached blocks; until then the runtime row is reported but NOT used to rank the bases.

verdict_by_notion.algebraically_simpler: NOT ESTABLISHED. Both are five-block, bracket-free, coefficient-free contractions with 15 edges. The block differs (N4125 vs N1050) but neither is algebraically simpler on this metric.
verdict_by_notion.computationally_faster: NOT ESTABLISHED by these measurements. The 119 ms vs 890 ms gap is dominated by block caching, not by the contraction. See metric_note.
verdict_by_notion.free_from_AMB_02: YES -- vacuously; there is no bracket to disambiguate.
verdict_by_notion.merely_an_alternative_basis: This is the accurate default description except for source robustness, where it is strictly better.
verdict_by_notion.minimal_within_evaluated_pilot: Within the N4125^5 sector, which WAS fully enumerated (15 of 15 canonical candidates), removal minimality holds: dropping any element drops rank to 2.
verdict_by_notion.minimal_within_reverse_generated_class: NO. Not established. The class was sampled, not swept.
verdict_by_notion.more_source_robust: YES, and this is the one clear advantage. The pure-N basis uses no explicit bracket, so no reading ambiguity can apply to it. The published basis contains P10_11, whose quotient image moves between AMB-02 readings.
verdict_by_notion.notationally_simpler: NOT ESTABLISHED. Formula lengths are comparable; both need five six-index factors and fifteen index pairs.
